inicio.thePriceBecomesTheBuild: The price becomes the build-up price at the standard size.
inicio.thePriceBecomesCostMarkup: The price becomes cost × markup, as a variable price: it follows the cost and keeps the target profit.
inicio.couldnTReadThePricing: Couldn't read the pricing parameters ( {parametersError}). The simulation below doesn't include the charges; the price is checked when you save.
inicio.thisItemDoesnTHave: This item doesn't have a calculated cost yet. The price can be set once the cost appears.
inicio.enterTheMonthSAverage: Enter the month's average sales to see the estimate.
inicio.noItemsMatchTheSelected: No items match the selected status and search.
inicio.selectTheItemsOnThis: Select the items on this page
inicio.theProductPriceIsSet: The product price is set in the product record
inicio.thePriceIsTheOne: The price is the one in the product record: the margin shows the result.
inicio.thePriceChargedIsUp: The price charged is up to you: the margin shows the result.
inicio.youDonTHavePermission: You don't have permission to view pricing.
inicio.bringsLaborMachineMaterialAnd: Brings labor, machine, material and product prices together in one place.

maoDeObra.theHourForEachProduction: The hour for each production department, with the cost coming from the Cost base.

maquinas.oneRowPerProductionSetup: One row per production setup. Groups of equivalent assets appear as a single row.

materiais.whenAMaterialHasVariants: When a material has variants, the row is the variant: that is where cost and price live.

produtos.aProductWithoutABuild: A product without a build-up appears as cost not calculated, never as zero margin.

resumo.costOfPaymentMethodsFees: Cost of payment methods, fees and early receipts.
resumo.theProfitMarginYouWant: The profit margin you want to achieve.
resumo.theyApplyToTheWhole: They apply to the whole company and make up the reference markup.
resumo.whenYouSaveThePrice: When you save, the price of every variable-price item is recalculated with the new parameters, keeping each item's profit. A fixed price doesn't change: its margin does.
resumo.chargesAndProfitAddUp: Charges and profit add up to 100% or more.
resumo.noMarkupCanCoverThem: No markup can cover them: adjust the parameters so the suggested price can be calculated again.
resumo.usedToCalculateTheSuggested: Used to calculate the suggested price. The price charged can be adjusted to the market.
resumo.includesTheTargetMarginIt: Includes the target margin. It is the value used for the suggested price in all groups.
resumo.eachGroupSTotalIs: Each group's total is the sum of priced items and pending ones.
